headline: Sensex drops 329 points and Nifty falls below 23,350 amid IT sell-off and F&O expiry

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: IT stocks extended declines and dragged market sentiment down.
F&O expiry created volatility during the trading session.
Brent crude fluctuations impacted market directional momentum.
Initial gains from crude price corrections gave way to afternoon selling pressure.
whatHappening: Sensex ended 329 points lower while Nifty closed below the 23,350 mark.
Parag Milk Foods announced an investment of ₹100 crore to expand paneer production.
SpiceJet came under financial scrutiny with DGCA reviewing its finances.
PhonePe secured payment licenses in the UAE to support Aani and Jaywan platforms.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices closed lower today, with the Sensex dropping 329 points and Nifty falling below 23,350.
Weakness in IT stocks and F&O expiry pressure erased early gains achieved from cooling crude oil prices.
In corporate news, Parag Milk Foods announced capacity expansion while SpiceJet faced regulatory financial scrutiny.
